course.description:
By the end of this 16-week course, students would be capable of:
● Explain the scientific, institutional, and systemic foundations of sustainability in the Anthropocene
● Critically evaluate sustainability governance frameworks (SDGs, ESG, ISO, reporting standards)
● Analyse organisations and systems using advanced systems-thinking approaches
● Design sustainability interventions that integrate governance, innovation and leadership
● Demonstrate ethical and reflexive leadership suited to complex sustainability challenges
● Communicate sustainability insights effectively and professionally
course.objectives: Course keywords: Sustainability Governance, Systems Thinking, Circular Economy, Anthropocene, Reflexive Leadership, ESG Reporting, Just Transition, Fiduciary Duty      課程說明 Course DescriptionIn the Anthropocene, sustainability challenges are no longer peripheral to leadership— they define it. Climate change, biodiversity loss, inequality, and technological disruption are not merely technical failures but failures of governance, innovation, and leadership.This course responds to the growing recognition that effective sustainability leadership requires the ability to navigate the tension between:● Scientific and data-driven “Truth” (planetary boundaries, lifecycle analysis, carbon accounting),● Systemic and ethical “Harmony” (ecological integrity, social justice, interdependence), and● Practical “Governance” (standards, metrics, institutions, accountability).Bridging global policy and organisational practice, the course equips postgraduate students with the frameworks (ISO, ESG, SDGs), innovation strategies (Circular Economy, sustainable finance, digital tools), and leadership capacities needed to design and lead systemic sustainability interventions under real-world constraints指定用書 TextbooksKrauss, L. M. (2025) The physics of climate change. London: Head of Zeus.Berners-Lee, M. (2026) A climate of truth : why we need it and how to get it. Cambridge, United Kingdom ; Cambridge University Press.de Beaufort, V., Enrione, A., Winchester, D., et al. (2025) Sustainable corporate governance: advanced theories and innovations shaping the future of corporate leadership. London: GBP Publications.Charles III et al. (2026) Harmony : the King’s vision for our world. London: William Collins.McAteer, P. (2021) Sustainability is the new advantage: leadership, change, and the future of business. London: Anthem Press.McDonough, W. & Braungart, M. (2009) Cradle to cradle : remaking the way we make things. London: Vintage.參考書籍 ReferencesBoeker, E. & Grondelle, R. van (2011) Environmental physics: sustainable energy and climate change. 3rd edition. Chichester: Wiley.Sustainable Corporate Governance: Advanced Theories and Innovations Shaping the Future of Corporate Leadership (2025). London: GBP Publications.教學方式 Teaching Approach● Lectures,● Assessment of Practical frameworks● Workshops● Simulations● Roleplay● Personal Reflection● Peer Learning評分標準 GradingAssessment 1: Week 5 - "The Leverage Point” Systems Map and explanatory brief (Individual), 30%,Assessment 2: Week 12 - "The Boardroom Simulation": Governance Strategy - 2,500- word strategy document & 15 min presentation, (Group), 40%Assessment 3: Week 16 - 3 Reflexive Memos & a 1,500-word personal manifesto, & class discussion (Individual), 30%,教學進度 Course SchedulePart 1: Foundations & Systems Thinking● Week 1: The Anthropocene & Planetary Boundaries Introduction to the science of sustainability and the physical limits of the Earth system.● Week 2: Systems Thinking for Leaders Mapping interdependencies and identifying leverage points for systemic change.● Week 3: Evolution of Corporate Responsibility From CSR to ESG—analysing the historical shift in how businesses view their role in society.Part 2: Sustainability Governance● Week 4: Global Policy Landscapes Detailed analysis of the UN SDGs, the Paris Agreement and the influence of international treaties on local business operations.● Week 5: Corporate Governance & Stakeholder Capitalism The legal and fiduciary duties of directors; shifting from shareholder value to stakeholder impact.  o Assessment 1: The "Leverage Point" Systems Map (Individual)● Week 6: ISO 14001: Environmental Management Systems (EMS) An introduction to the "Plan-Do-Check-Act" (PDCA) cycle. Understanding how to implement a systematic framework to manage environmental responsibilities and improve performance.● Week 7: Reporting, Disclosure, and Transparency Navigating frameworks like GRI and TCFD to ensure data integrity and prevent greenwashing.Part 3: Leading Sustainable Change● Week 8: Values-based & Purpose-Driven Leadership Exploring the psychological and ethical frameworks required to lead in a volatile, uncertain world.● Week 9: Change Management & Organisational Culture Tools for overcoming internal resistance and embedding sustainability into the core strategy and daily operations.● Week 10: Multi-Stakeholder Collaboration Managing complex partnerships across sectors (NGOs, Government and Industry) to address collective challenges.Part 4: Innovation & Circular Models● Week 11: The Circular Economy & Regenerative Design Transitioning from linear "take-make-dispose" models to circular value chains and product-as-a service.● Week 12: Assessment 2: The Boardroom Simulation: Group strategy document and pitches.● Week 13: Sustainable Finance & Impact Investment Understanding the role of capital markets, green bonds, and ESG metrics in investment decisions.● Week 14: Technological Disruptors Techno-communitarianism and the application of AI, blockchain and green tech in tracking supply chain integrity and reducing footprints.Part 5: Ethics & The Future● Week 15: Ethics, Harmony and the Just Transition Exploring how social justice and nature’s patterns inform a holistic leadership approach to the "Just Transition."● Week 16: The "Legacy & Launch" Workshop   o Assessment 3: Reflexive Leadership Portfolio   o The Peer-Reflexive Exchange: High-energy "Speed-Mentoring" and "Shadow Inquiries" to stress-test students’ ethical boundaries and examine how personal biases impact corporate governance.   o The "Just Transition" World Café: An immersive workshop applying students’ leadership manifestos to resolve "unsolvable" micro-cases involving planetary boundaries, social justice, and supply chain integrity.   o The 2040 Simulation & Closing: A "future-back" press statement aligning manifesto principles with the Paris Agreement, followed by a final reflection on the course text—such as Charles III (2026)—that most profoundly shifted leadership mental models.Appendix 1: Example assessments1. The "Leverage Point" Systems Map (Individual - 30%)Context: Aligned with Part 1: Foundations & Systems Thinking.● The Task: Students select a specific industrial sustainability challenge (e.g., semiconductor water scarcity or global textile waste). They must produce a visual Systems Map identifying interdependencies and "leverage points" for sustainable systemic change.● Students submit a systems map accompanied by a 1,000-word explanatory brief.This tests their ability to analyse organisations and systems using advanced systems-thinking approaches.2. The Boardroom Simulation: Governance & Innovation (Group - 40%) Context: Aligned with Part 2 & 4: Governance and Innovation.● The Task: In small groups, students act as "Sustainability Steering Committees" for a multinational organisation. They are presented with a "crisis scenario" (see Table 1) involving a conflict between planetary boundaries and fiduciary duties. This requires students to navigate the tension between "Scientific Truth" and "Practical Governance".● Deliverables: 1. A Governance framework: A 2,500-word strategy document incorporating ISO 14001 principles, ESG metrics and Circular Economy transitions. 2. The "Pitch": A 15-minute live presentation defending their strategy against "greenwashing" scrutiny.3. Reflexive Leadership Portfolio (Individual - 30%)Context: Aligned with Part 3 & 5: Leadership and Ethics.● The Task: A cumulative portfolio that tracks the student’s evolution through the 16 weeks. It must include three "Reflexive Memos"responding to course insights. Students will be expected to use this in class during week 16.● The Final Entry: A 1,500-word personal manifesto on "Ethical and Reflexive Leadership" that uses the three Reflexive Memos as evidence.Table 1. Crises for Part 2 – The Boardroom SimulationSupply Chain & Planetary Boundaries1. The "Hidden" Deforestation: A major supplier in the Amazon is linked to illegal land clearing, threatening the firm's ISO 14001 certification and triggering a massive social media boycott.2. Water Scarcity Shutdown: A semiconductor plant’s primary water source is depleted due to climate change, forcing a choice between maintaining production or protecting the local community's water rights.3. The Cobalt Conundrum: A shift to EV batteries is revealed to rely on child labour in the DRC, pitting the firm's "Green Innovation" goals against human rights ethics.4. Biodiversity Litigation: Construction of a new "Green Campus" is halted because it sits on the migratory path of an endangered species, leading to a lawsuit from an environmental NGO.Governance & Reporting Scandals5. The Greenwashing Whistleblower: An internal auditor reveals that the company’s GRI and TCFD disclosures have inflated carbon sequestration figures by 40%.6. Scope 3 Shock: New EU regulations suddenly require full Scope 3 reporting, revealing that the company’s indirect emissions are ten times higher than previously disclosed to investors.7. The Fiduciary Rebellion: Shareholders sue the board for "waste of corporate assets" after the CEO commits to a Net Zero target that significantly reduces short-term dividends.8. The ESG Rating Crash: A major rating agency downgrades the firm from "A" to "CCC" overnight due to a data breach of employee personal information, causing institutional investors to divest.Innovation & Circular Economy Failures9. Circular Design Backfire: A "Product-as-a-Service" model results in high return rates and logistical emissions that exceed the footprint of the original linear model.10. The Toxic "Bio-Plastic": A new biodegradable packaging line is found to release microplastics into the soil, damaging the firm's reputation for Regenerative Design.11.AI Energy Surge: The implementation of AI for supply chain integrity causes the firm’s data centre energy consumption to skyrocket, breaching its Paris Agreement alignment.12. The "Right to Repair" Protest: A tech firm faces a backlash for software locking its devices, contradicting the Circular Economy principles taught in its own marketing.Ethical & Leadership Dilemmas13. The Just Transition Strike: Closing a coal-intensive factory to meet carbon goals leads to a total town shutdown and massive labour strikes, challenging the "Just Transition" framework.14. Political Conflict of Interest: A major political donor demands the company lobby against a new carbon tax that the Sustainability Committee has publically endorsed.15. The Hostile "Anti-ESG" Takeover: An activist investor gains a board seat with the sole intent of dismantling the sustainability department to focus on "pure profit."16. Carbon Offset Fraud: The company's massive investment in forest offsets is revealed to be "phantom credits" because the forest was destroyed by wildfire.Systemic & Institutional Disruptions17. The Regulatory "Cliff": A sudden change in government results in the immediate removal of all renewable energy subsidies, making a flagship "Green Tech" project financially unviable.18. Global Treaty Sanctions: A failure to meet new international biodiversity standards leads to the company being blacklisted from exporting to the European market.19. The Tech-Communitarian Crisis: A local community seizes the firm's decentralized micro-grid during a national energy crisis, claiming "Common Good" over corporate ownership.20. Planetary Boundary "Tipping Point": An abrupt climate event (e.g., a major permafrost melt) causes a global insurance market collapse, making it impossible to insure the firm's coastal assets.

course.titleEn: Taiwan Electricity Market and Energy Strategy
course.syllabusSource: 清大官方課程系統大綱（由 NTHUMods 公開索引整理）
course.description:
本課程以台灣電力市場與能源戰略為主題，從電力系統物理、法制制度、市場設計、能源轉型與地緣政治風險等面向，探討台
灣在高進口依賴、孤島電網、高科技產業用電成長與淨零轉型壓力下，如何維持供電穩定並強化能源韌性。課程內容涵蓋頻率
與備轉、輔助服務、儲能與需求反應、綠電交易、LNG 與咽喉點風險、AI 與半導體用電、核能與核廢料、漁電共生、BIPV、
電價補貼及國際能源危機應變。透過案例分析與政策討論，培養學生理解電力市場作為風險治理與轉型工具的能力。
course.objectives: Course keywords: 台灣電力市場,Taiwan power market,能源安全與風險治理,Energy security and risk governance,能源轉型與電網韌性      課程大綱 (Course Syllabus)1. 課程說明 (Course Description)本課程以「台灣電力市場與能源戰略」為主題，從電力系統物理、法制制度、市場設計、能源轉型與地緣政治風險等面向，探討台灣在高進口依賴、孤島電網、高科技產業用電成長與淨零轉型壓力下，如何維持供電穩定並強化能源韌性。課程內容涵蓋頻率與備轉、輔助服務、儲能與需求反應、綠電交易、LNG 與咽喉點風險、AI 與半導體用電、核能與核廢料、漁電共生、BIPV、電價補貼及國際能源危機應變。透過案例分析、文件閱讀與課堂討論，培養學生理解電力市場作為風險治理與轉型工具的能力，並能就台灣未來電力治理提出具證據基礎的分析與建議。2. 指定用書 (Text Books)本課程不採單一教科書，以下列教材與教師每週投影片為主要指定閱讀：Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC), Energy Primer: A Handbook of Energy Market BasicsInternational Energy Agency (IEA), Electricity 2025台灣電力股份有限公司電力交易平台與系統運轉相關教材經濟部能源署與相關主管機關官方文件3. 參考書籍 (References)Paul L. Joskow and Jean Tirole, electricity market related articles and readingsSteven Stoft, Power System Economics: Designing Markets for ElectricityInternational Energy Agency (IEA), reports on electricity, power security, and clean energy transitionsFERC, PJM, AEMO, and ENTSO-E official market and system operation materialsEuropean Commission, Accelerate EU–Energy Union: Affordable and Secure Energy through Accelerated ActionE3G, Beyond Securing Supply: Chokepoint Risk for Oil and Gas ImportersCarbon Brief, analyses on global energy crisis responses台灣電力公司永續報告書、電力交易平台文件、系統調度與輔助服務資料國家再生能源憑證中心、再生能源發展條例、電業法等官方資料4. 教學方式 (Teaching Methods)教師講授政策文件與技術資料導讀個案分析與課堂討論分組報告與口頭簡報期中與期末整合報告5. 教學進度 (Course Schedule)Week 1課程導論：重新定義電力市場Week 2台灣電力系統的高風險結構：孤島電網、進口依賴與高負載產業Week 3電力系統物理：即時平衡、頻率、慣性與控制Week 4法制邊界：電業法、市場邊界與制度配置Week 5台灣電力交易平台與輔助服務商品Week 6儲能、需求反應與虛擬電廠Week 7市場出清、價格形成與資源充足性Week 8期中報告Week 9綠電交易、T-REC、企業 PPA 與大用戶策略Week 10高比例再生能源系統、停電案例與電網韌性Week 11LNG 依賴、咽喉點風險與能源安全Week 12AI、資料中心、半導體與高科技產業用電Week 13核能、核廢料與制度誠實Week 14漁電共生、BIPV 與地方治理衝突Week 15電價、補貼、節能與危機溝通Week 16期末報告6. 成績考核 (Evaluation)課堂參與及討論：20%閱讀紀要／短評或小作業：20%期中報告：25%期末報告：35%請假與出席規定 (Leave and Attendance Policy)依《國立清華大學學生請假辦法》辦理。本課程另補充規定如下：學生若因病假、公假、喪假或其他正當事由無法到課，請依學校規定完成請假程序，並主動通知授課教師。未經請假或未完成程序之缺席，視為無故缺席。缺席課堂如涉及分組討論、口頭報告或課堂活動，學生須自行與教師協商補交或補做方式，教師得視活動性質決定是否接受補作。期中與期末報告如需請假，須事先通知並提出證明；未依規定辦理者，該項成績得酌予扣減。7. 採用下列何項 AI 使用規則 (AI Usage Policy)有條件開放，請註明如何使用生成式 AI 於課程產出8. 與課程相關的網站 (Course-related Website / Personal Website)經濟部能源署台灣電力公司台電電力交易平台國家再生能源憑證中心International Energy Agency (IEA)FERC / PJM / AEMO / ENTSO-E 官方網站

course.description:
本課程主要是邀請半導體公司主管或專家探討新的半導體技術未來發展，並了解其應用趨勢，讓學生更清楚未來就業方向。內容 
更包括一些技術原理和流程，使學生在學習專業知識之外，更能理解半導體生態和未來職場上的運作機制。

course.description: 學生經指導教授同意至合適的半導體相關產業或研究單位進行實習，拓展學習視野並習得學以致用之實務經驗。
course.objectives: Course keywords: 業界實習      1.實習說明學生經指導教授同意至合適的半導體相關產業或研究單位進行實習，拓展學習視野並習得學以致用之實務經驗。2.教學方式(1)實習前與指導教授討論實習單位，確認實習單位是否錄取。(2)備妥實習申請書、實習機構同意書、實習機構聘僱通知書向學院提出申請。(3)申請書審核通過後，請以加簽方式選課-CSR500300業界實習。(4)至實習單位實習160小時以上完成學習，並繳交實習成果報告、實習考核表。3.成績考核(1)請於實習最後一週完成實習成果報告、實習考核表，並請實習單位主管評核。(2)請於開學的第一週繳實習成果報告、實習考核表予學院辦公室。(3)實習成果報告、實習考核表為實習成績的依據，未繳回者無法核予實習學分及成績，請實習前務必先讓實習單位主管了解，實習結束需請其填寫及簽核相關實習文件。4.相關網站申請實習表單及更多實習資訊請參閱學院官網。

course.description:
Semiconductor memories have mainly two uses. One is for the calculation by exchanging data with CPU, 
MPU, etc. The other is for the mass data storage. Demands for these two applications are following; 
1. Low cost and high density, 2. High speed operation, 3. Low power consumption. Therefore, memory 
technologies have been evolved more than 30 years to satisfy these demands. Moreover, new 
application has been noticed for the calculation of AI which is called in memory computing. 
Furthermore, memory device and CPU/MPU are connected chip-to-chip and can get quite high speed and 
low power operation. I will introduce these new technologies. Following are the outline of the 
course. Part1: Basic concept of memories: 1. DRAM & SARM 2.NOR-Flash 3. NAND-Flash Part2: 1. 3D 
NAND, In-memory computing for AI calculation.
course.objectives: Course keywords: Semiconductor memory, Flash memory, DRAM, 3 dimensional memory cell, In memory computing      Syllabus of the course (3D and Next Generation Memories), from 2025 SeptemberRecent semiconductor memory technologies are studied in this course.Part 1. Fundamentals of MOSFET operationPart 2. Basic concept of the semiconductor memories1. DRAM & SARM2. NOR-Flash3. NAND-FlashPart 3. Recent device and process technologies of 3D NAND-FlashPart 4. Reliability of NAND-FlashPart 5. Issues of recent DRAM and its new technology trendPart 6. New application of memory: in memory computing for AISoring method:attendance score = 20%, middle quiz = 40%, final quiz = 40%.

course.description:
At nanoscale nodes, physics creates constraints, system architecture sets
objectives, and leadership determines who captures value.
Students learn how DTCO evolved into STCO and why different companies won (or
lost) across mobile → AI training → edge AI inflections.
course.objectives: Course keywords:  Leadership, Nanoscale CMOS Technology, Phoenix and Unicorn, Innovation with Uncertainty,Semiconductor Ecosystem      一、開課目的(Course purpose)：At nanoscale nodes, physics creates constraints, system architecture sets objectives, and leadership determines who captures value.Students learn how DTCO evolved into STCO and why different companies won (or lost) across mobile → AI training → edge AI inflections.二、課程說明(Course description)：This course analyzes the semiconductor industry through five pivotal firms including TSMC, Intel, AMD, NVIDIA and ASML. Together, they form a closed system of co-evolution, where:R26;No firm innovates in isolation R26;Technology roadmaps are interdependent Leadership decisions propagate across the ecosystemStudents will learn to:R26;Map cross-company interdependencies (e.g., ASML → TSMC → NVIDIA) R26;Distinguish process leadership vs. architectural leadership vs. equipment leverageR26;Evaluate strategic asymmetry across the value chain R26;Diagnose Phoenix vs. Unicorn transitions within the same firm over time三、教學進度(Course Schedule)：2026/9/11更新版11 weeks(密集/彈性上課)時間：週五上午09:00-12:00Week 1-Class Date 9/11Introduction to Nanoscale CMOS Technology Development and Leadership	Week 2-Class Date 9/25	Book Reading: The Phoenix & The Unicorn – Peter Hinssen (Chapter 1 ~ 3)	Week 3-Class Date 10/2Session 1 - how we manage to integrate billions of transistors to perform complex functions. This course focuses

course.description:
This course is devoted to the fundamental knowledge of Very Large-Scale Integration (VLSI) circuits 
testing and diagnosis. The emphasis has two parts: 1. on investigating various technically feasible 
test solutions and design-for-test hardware to ensure the overall testability and quality of 
manufactured ICs. 2. on investigating various diagnosis solutions and design-for-diagnosis hardware 
to ensure the overall diagnosis quality. It begins with fault modeling and fault simulation, followed 
by algorithms for Automatic Test Pattern Generation (ATPG). Then, widely adopted design-for-test 
techniques. At the final stage, diagnosis and design-for-diagnosis for failing dies will be 
discussed.

course.description:
This course is designed to teach the core technologies and theories of semiconductor process 
integration, with a strong focus on three fundamental manufacturing processes: photolithography, 
thin-
film deposition, and etching. Utilizing CMOS process technology as the primary framework, the 
course 
systematically covers the complete manufacturing flow, starting from front-end-of-line (FEOL) 
processes, such as silicon wafer cleaning, through to back-end-of-line (BEOL) metal interconnect 
integration. Through this course, students will build a solid foundation in industry-standard 
semiconductor manufacturing processes and acquire the practical skills necessary for future advanced 
academic research and development.

course.description:
本課程為因應次世代半導體元件發展趨勢所設計之高階半導體製程技術課程。課程核心聚焦於鰭式電晶體（FinFET）之先進製
程整合技術及其可靠度分析。內容全面接軌國際頂尖半導體指標會議（如 IEDM、VLSI Symposia）之精選教材，兼具前瞻理論
深度與產業實務前沿。
為落實「理論、實務、前瞻視野」三位一體之教學目標，本課程特別導入雙軌實務訓練：學生將於國立清華大學奈米微系統與奈
米材料技術中心（奈材中心）進行核心半導體製程之實作操作，並安排至台灣半導體研究中心（TSRI）進行實地技術參訪，深入
對接業界現役最先進之半導體製程與分析檢測設備。本課程旨在培育具備獨立元件分析能力、熟悉次世代先進製程整合之高階半
導體研發人才。
course.objectives: Course keywords: 半導體技術 (semiconductor technology), 鰭式場效電晶體技術 (FINFET transistor technology), 半導體製程技術 (Semiconductor Process Technology), 半導體製造 (Semiconductor Manufacturing), 半導體設備 (Semiconductor Equipmant)      A:課程說明 (Course Description): 本課程專為電子、材料、奈米元件相關領域之研究所碩博士生設計。隨平面 MOSFET 物理極限之挑戰，FinFET 成為邁入次世代（3nm/2nm 及更先進節點）不可或缺的核心架構。本課程為進階課程，請務必先修習半導體元件物理及半導體製程導論或相關課程。課程由三大核心模塊組成：模塊一：FinFET 前沿元件物理與製程原理剖析三維通道之靜電學、量子局限效應、漏電機制；探討應變力工程（Strained-Si）、High-k/metal Gate (HKMG) 之 Vt 調整工程及後段（BEOL）高階金屬化製程。塊二：清大奈材中心製程實務操作進入黃光、蝕刻、薄膜沉積等無塵室實際製程操作，加強理論與實務的連結。模塊三：TSRI 頂尖研究環境與產線設備參訪親臨台灣半導體研究中心，觀摩國家級無塵室與產線同級之先進製程/量測儀器。 再次提醒: 本課程為進階課程，請務必先修習半導體元件物理及半導體製程導論或相關課程。B:指定用書與參考書籍R26;	指定用書: 上課講義，內容涵蓋精選自歷年國際電子元件大會 (IEDM) 及國際固態電路論壇 (VLSI Symposia) 的資料。R26;	參考書籍 (Reference Books): 無C. 教學方式 (Teaching Methods): 本課程採理論與實務並重之教學模式，整體教學比重規劃為：課堂理論導讀 (50%)、無塵室製程實作 (35%)、產研機構實地教學 (15%)。學期總整進度之架構規劃如下（不含彈性調整週）：理論課程模塊（共 8 週）：探討 FinFET 元件物理、應變力技術、臨界電壓（Vt）調整、High-k/metal Gate 製程、高階金屬化製程，內容主要由 IEDM / VLSI 精選文獻為主。實作課程模塊（共 6 週）：於清華大學奈材中心無塵室進行半導體製程實作訓練（涵蓋黃光微影、薄膜沉積、乾/濕式蝕刻及元件微結構量測分析）。機構參訪模塊（共 2 週）：赴台灣半導體研究中心（TSRI）實地教學，參觀國家級頂尖半導體研究環境，並認識多項與業界現役同級之最先進半導體製程與檢測設備。進度彈性調整說明：以上時數與模塊順序為初步規劃。因涉及無塵室操作安全與外部資源對接，實際授課週次與時程安排，將依據「清大奈材中心無塵室」之容納與排程狀況，以及「台灣半導體研究中心（TSRI）」之實際預約開放狀況進行彈性調整。D: 成績考核方式本課程採取客觀且具備實務導向之評量標準，各項評分占比如下：R26;出席率 (30%)：包含理論課堂參與、無塵室實作準時度與移地參訪之出席表現。R26;理論課程期中考 (40%)：評量重點為 FinFET 元件物理機制、應力工程與 HKMG 製程整合核心觀念。奈材中心實作考試 (30%)：評期於清大奈材中心無塵室之實際操作熟練度、製程參數掌握度與實驗安全規範落實度。特別請假規定（重要爭議防範）：💡 請假特別聲明：因本課程包含**「清大奈材中心無塵室實作」與「TSRI 移地參訪」等不可替代之核心時程，除依本校學生請假辦法規定之不可抗力公假、病假、喪假外，凡涉及實作與參訪之週次，均不得事後要求單獨補課或補實作。若因故缺席且未於三天前**出具官方正式證明完成請假手續者，該次實作/參訪分數以零分計算，以維護實驗室操作安全與教學資源之公平性。

course.description:
本課程極適合想從事於製程整合和各模組的工程師，內容的重點，並不是在化學反應，而是在學生邏輯的思考，所以課程內容着重
在邏輯思考並在授課過程中講解很多在半導體製程上所遇到的實際例子。最基本的半導體廠內所用化學品介紹起並敘述工廠內如何
做好污染防治，接下來介紹各模組所用的化學品及其相關製程如蝕刻，再介紹化學機械平坦製程上有關的化學反應。至於在黃光製
程方面，從g/i-line一直講到EUV光阻在二奈米以下應用。另外還有特殊處理劑如降低LER, 增加選擇比等的和雙層/三層黃光製
程。
course.objectives: Course keywords: Chemical material, CMP, etch, litho, semiconductor process, resist, semiconductor fab, clean room, EUV      1.課程說明最基本的半導體廠內所用化學品介紹起並敘述工廠內如何做好污染防治，讓良率提高，包括有氣體還有化學液體和管路如何做好，在無塵室裡如何做到class等級由10000變1000再變成100，如何做到迷你環境的class 1。接下來就介紹各模組所用的化學品及其相關的製程如晶圓潔淨(wafer clean)製程: 晶圓清潔之目的係移除所有表面污染物：微粒、有機物、金屬與原生氧化物。每一個製造步驟，皆可能污染晶圓表面之元件。因此完成一整個 ULSI 製造步驟，估計每個晶圓至少需經過濕式清潔100次以上，課程內容包括有RCA清潔:SC-1,SC-2,Piranha 混合溶液的介紹與使用方法，再配合一些新的清洗設備，比如超音波/刷洗/噴灑/熱DI等。蝕刻(etch)製程部分: 半導體製程包括兩種基本形式的蝕刻製程，乾蝕刻與濕蝕刻乾蝕刻，乾蝕刻根據所需移除材料的類型而分類，三種主要的蝕刻材料分類包括有金屬蝕刻、介電質蝕刻及矽蝕刻，除因基材不同而使用適當氣體種類外，亦詳細講解蝕刻工程師在發展配方時所要檢查的十大項目: 蝕刻速率、蝕刻輪廓(profile) 、蝕刻偏差(etch bias) 、選擇性、均一性(uniformity) 、殘留物、聚合物形成、電漿引起的破壞、微粒污染及缺陷、蝕刻速率。至於濕蝕刻方面，主要是講解BOE(Buffer Oxide Etch), 在半導體如STI製程上的應用與控制。再介紹化學機械平坦(CMP)製程上有關的化學反應、研磨墊高分子材料,pattern loading等。還有針對氧化物、鎢金屬、銅金屬所使用的研漿(slurry)與其製程作介紹。至於在黃光(Litho)製程方面，從g/i-line光反應一直講到248光阻和193光阻，再講解 EUV光阻在七奈米以下的黃光製程應用。另一方面，再從有機光阻再介紹到金屬氧化物類的無機光阻。光阻配方中有acid diffusion和quencher角色對光阻性能的影響有詳細的講解，至於BARC的化學組成和作用亦屬於黃光製程的重點，另外還有特殊的降低LER, 增加選擇比等等的處理劑，最後有時間再介紹先進製程上的雙層/三層黃光製程。2.指定用書 (Text Books): none3.參考書籍 (References): none4.教學方式 (Teaching Methods): 在課堂上直接授課, 平時請學生自願上台表達或分組討論來增加平時分數。5.教學進度 (Course Schedule): A.半導體廠內化學品種類及其應用與廠內污染控制(5 weeks)●1st week: 化學材料安全及廠內常用的氣體液體化學製程●2nd week: 半導體廠內污染控制及廠務設備介紹●3rd week(小考): 無塵室的規劃設置與潔淨度(如class 100)的控制●4th week: 晶圓潔淨(wafer clean)所用的化學品●5th week(小考): 晶圓潔淨的化學製程和小考或分組討論B.半導體廠內乾式/濕式蝕刻(dry/wet etch)所用的化學品及其相關的製程(3 weeks)●6th week: 十大蝕刻參數的介紹與製程配方建立的相關性●7th week: 乾蝕刻的應用及相關底層蝕刻的化學●8th week(小考): 濕蝕刻的應用及相關的化學和小考或分組討論C.半導體廠內化學機械平坦(CMP)所用的化學品及其相關的製程(2 weeks)●9th week: 傳統平坦化和化學機械平坦所用的化學品及製程●10th week(小考): CMP 研漿(slurry)與底層基材的關係，研磨墊片(PVA)介紹和小考或分組討論D.半導體廠內黃光(Litho) 所用的化學品及其相關的製程(6 weeks)●11th week: i-line/KrF光阻光化學/BARC化學介紹●12th week: 製程設備中常見的問題與解決如substrate poison, airborne contamination, standing curve etc.●13th week(小考): track中光阻每一製程步驟的目地介紹和小考或分組討論●14th week: ArF光阻光化學和分子設計●15th week:immersion 光阻設計及所遇到問題和解決方法●16th week(小考): CAR type 和無機金屬EUV光阻的介紹和小考或分組討論6.成績考核 (Evaluation):A.小考或分組討論分享(50%)B.出席, 分組或個人的平時或上課小作業, 小考(50%)7.AI使用規則: 本課程無涉及AI使用 Not applicable8.與課程相關的網站 (Course-related Website)(Personal Website): none

course.description:
Introductory course for semiconductor plasma process induced damage to device including physical 
damage, electrical damage, contamination and their recovery and prevention strategy.
course.objectives: Course keywords: Plasma process damage, Plasma charging, Wafer arcing, Antenna charge collection design rule, Device damage mechanism, Diagnostic technique      課程說明(Course description)：Plasma process induced device damage has affected the semiconductor industry since 1980. The damage including physical, electrical, contamination and others has great impact on semiconductor production yield and modulates device design rule for decades. This course will discuss the detailed mechanism and the prevention methods from process, equipment, device and design point of view to address this issue.指定用書(Textbooks)1. Class notes.2.“CMOS plasma and Process Damage” by Kirk Prall, Springer, Switzerland, 2025.參考書籍(Reference books)1. “Plasma Charging Damage” by Kin P. Cheung, Springer-Verlag, London, 2001.教學方式 (Teaching Methods)The course will have both lectures and homework/research projects with real case study to understand the details of plasma process induced damage mechanism and solutions教學進度 (Course Schedule)Week 1: Plasma process induced damage overviewWeek 2: Physical DamageWeek 3: Electrical DamageWeek 4: Plasma Induced ContaminationWeek 5: Plasma damage mechanismWeek 6: Plasma charging damageWeek 7: Plasma process induced wafer arcingWeek 8: Plasma UV radiation damageWeek 9: Midterm research projectWeek 10: Plasma Damage diagnostic：Probe/optical measurementWeek 11: Plasma Damage diagnostic：Monitor wafer/Device measurementWeek 12: Plasma Damage preventionWeek 13: Process/Integration optimizationWeek 14: Device design rule optimization/Protection diodeWeek 15: Chamber design improvementWeek 16: Final research project成績評量方式(Evaluation)Homework 40%, Midterm project report 20%, Final research project report 30%, Classroom participation 10%AI 使用規則 (Select Applicable AI Usage Policy Policy)Conditionally open; specify generative AI usage in course output.

course.description:
一、開課目的(Course purpose)：
A comprehensive guide to 2.5D and 3DIC advanced semiconductor packaging technology
course.objectives: Course keywords: 2.5D/3D integration, Through-silicon vias (TSV), advanced semiconductor packaging, tsmc CoWoS, Intel EMIB, 3DIC Cu-Cu hybrid bonding, Thermal management, Co-Packaged Optics (CPO)      二、課程說明(Course description)：This class fully explains the latest microelectronics techniques for increasing chip density and maximizing performance while reducing power consumption. This practical guide teaches the trade-offs inherent in making system-level decisions. Explore key enabling technologies such as TSV, thin-wafer handling, micro-bumping, interposers, wafer-to-wafer bonding, chip-to-wafer bonding, 3DIC Cu-Cu hybrid bonding and Co-packaged optics. Assembly, thermal management, and reliability are covered in complete detail.三、課程內容大綱(Syllabus)：Week 1: 2.5D/3D integration for semiconductor IC packaging introductionWeek 2: Through-silicon vias (TSV) Week 3: Thin-wafer handlingWeek 4: Micro-bumping fabrication, assembly, and reliabilityWeek 5: 2.5D Packaging: tsmc CoWoS, Intel EMIB, …Week 6: 2.5D Packaging: CoWoS-S, CoWoS-L, CoWoS-R and Reliability Week 7: 2.5D Packaging: CoPoS (Chip on Panel on Substrate)Week 8: Midterm Exam.Week 9: Practical application and/or visitsWeek 10: Practical application and/or visitsWeek 11: 3DIC integrationWeek 12: 3DIC Cu-Cu hybrid bonding: Wafer-on-Wafer (WoW)Week 13: 3DIC Cu-Cu hybrid bonding: Chip-on-Wafer (CoW)Week 14: Thermal management of 2.5D/3D IC integrationWeek 15: Co-Packaged Optics (CPO)Week 16: Final Exam.四、成績評量方式(Grading Criteria)期中考40%、期末考40%、出席以及上課表現20%，合計100%。提醒：加總需為100%。五、指定教科書、參考書或教材來源(Sources of textbooks, reference books or teaching materials to be used)：Reference: Semiconductor Advanced Packaging, by John H. Lau.  IEEE ECTC Proceedings六、開課頻率(Course Offering Frequency)： □每學期  V每學年  □兩學年  □只開數次七、預計授課教師(Instructor)： 劉重希 採用下列何項 AI 使用規則 (Select Applicable AI Usage Policy Policy):完全開放使用且無須註明 Unrestricted use with no disclosure required

course.description:
本課程為教導學生半導體之光罩技術及知識，具理工科背景之大學或研究生均可修習。先進之光罩技術為半導體技術中之重要一
環，舉凡三奈米或二奈米世代及其他先進半導體世代，製程中皆含有一百片以上之先進光罩，光罩品質之精良與否或好壞會直接
影響產品之良率，並且光罩中之CD或overlay控制更直接影響製程之精良與否。並課程會以深入淺出之講授，教導學生了解光罩
之製作流程、品質控制及最前瞻之光罩技術，並從而具有光罩研究之基本能力，而能從事光罩之相關工作。
course.objectives: Course keywords: 微影技術，光罩，半導體，曝光機，解析度增進技術，lithography technology, mask, semiconductor, scanner, resolution enhancement technology      本課程為教導學生半導體之光罩技術，先進之光罩技術為半導體技術中之重要一環，舉凡三奈米或二奈米世代，便含有一百片以上之先進光罩，光罩品質之精良與否或好壞會直接影響產品之良率，並且光罩中之CD或overlay控制更直接影響製程之精良與否。並課程會以深入淺出之講授，教導學生了解光罩技術，並從而具有光罩研究之基本能力。列印講義參考書籍 Photomask Fabrication Technology, B.G.Eynon Jr., B. Wu教學方式 課堂講授教學進度1 Introduction - Material, Patterns, mask structure,Fabrication flow, products, issues2 Data preparation - MDP flow, Pattern fracturing3 Data preparation - Job DEKS, MDP process time4 Pattern Generation - Mask writing system, Pattern quality control5 Pattern Generation - Data system6 Pattern Transfer - Process, Plasma etching fundamentals7 Pattern Transfer - Cr etching, MoSi etching8 期中考9 Metrology - Introduction, CD metrology, AFM, Overlay10 Back end process - Introduction, inspection11 Back end process - Repair12 Back end process - Clean13 Resolution Enhancement Technology - Fourier Optics, scalar imaging14 Resolution Enhancement Technoloyg - OPC, PSM, Optimization15 Next Generation Mask - EUV mask, pellicle, inspection16 期末考成績考核 期中考試(40%), 作業(20%), 期末考試(40%)

course.description:
In the pursuit of academic research, excellence involves more than just conducting high-quality 
studies or writing outstanding papers; the ability to articulate ideas clearly and fluently during 
presentations is equally vital. An effective presentation not only conveys core findings and concepts 
in a concise and powerful manner but also helps researchers organize their thoughts and refine the 
logic behind their topic. This course covers essential public speaking techniques and slide design 
methods. Finally, through practical exercises and constructive feedback, we aim to elevate every 
student’s presentation capabilities. This course will be conducted in English mainly.
course.objectives: Course keywords: Academic, Oral, Slide design, Presentation Techniques, Public Speaking, English comprehension, Spoken English      課程說明 (Course Description)The course curriculum is primarily divided into two main components.Phase 1: Instruction and AnalysisThe instructor will first cover the key principles of slide design and effectivepresentation delivery skills, which will be reinforced through discussions andanalysis of video examples.Phase 2: Application and Peer FeedbackSubsequently, students will select their own topics and deliver a 25-minutepresentation to demonstrate the techniques learned in class. Each speech will befollowed by an immediate, real-time discussion where all students provide feedback and critique. This collaborative approach aims to achieve the goals of mutual learning and collective growth.指定用書 (Text Books)None參考書籍 (References)Talk Like TED: The 9 Public-Speaking Secrets of the World's Top Minds, Carmine GalloPresentation Zen: Simple Ideas on Presentation Design and Delivery, Garr Reynoldsslide:ology: The Art and Science of Creating Great Presentations, Nancy DuarteThe 3-Minute Rule: How to Speak so that People Actually Listen, Andrew Mavridis教學方式 (Teaching Methods)Slide Design for conference paper instructionVideo Analysis (Case Studies)In-Class Presentation PracticeEnglish resume constructionInterview oral skillPost-Performance Debriefing and Discussion教學進度 (Course Schedule)Weeks 1–4: Key Principles of Presentation Design, Analysis of Speaking Techniques,Discussion of Video Case Studies.Student resume construction and self-introductionWeeks 5–16: Student Presentations on their special topics and Group Discussion/Feedback.成績考核 (Evaluation)Grading will be based on the following weighted components:Oral Presentation: 30%Presentation Slides:30%Class Discussion: 10%Attendance: 30%AI 使用規則 (AI Usage Policy Policy)Conditionally open; specify generative AI usage in course output.

course.description:
為提供跨領域學習，增進科管院學生遊刃於科技、財經專業知識與大眾傳媒之能力，將透過本X-Class課程培養新聞編輯採訪技
能，以科管院所發行之E-news線上刊物為實作媒體，提升學生媒體素養及培養新聞報導之文字採訪撰寫編輯與視覺設計企劃編

course.description:
癌症是現代社會裡最致命的疾病，大部分的人碰到癌症時，總是聞之色變，將之視為絕症。但並不是每種癌症都這麼可怕，也有
許多診斷與治療的方法，因此本課程希望能夠讓學生具備有更多與癌症相關的正確知識，同時，也可增進跨領域的交流，讓更多
不同專長的學生投入癌症研究的相關新藥、診斷技術、與醫材的開發。
course.objectives: Course keywords: 癌症, 治療, 精準醫療, 癌症轉移, 健康檢查      ● 課程說明(Course Description)癌症是現代社會裡最致命的疾病，大部分的人碰到癌症時，總是聞之色變，將之視為絕症。但並不是每種癌症都這麼可怕，也有許多診斷與治療的方法，因此本課程希望能夠讓學生具備有更多與癌症相關的正確知識，同時，也可增進跨領域的交流，讓更多不同專長的學生投入癌症研究的相關新藥、診斷技術、與醫材的開發。● 指定用書(Text Books)本課程為自編講義● 參考書籍(References)1.	癌症大祕密：醫師很想說、你很想問的65個問題　出版社：如何2.	細胞反叛　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　出版社：天下文化● 教學方式(Teaching Method)教學方式主要以課堂理論講述與影片分享為主，前半學期會與學生介紹癌症發生的原因與目前常見的檢測及治療方法。在前二節課理論介紹完後會請每位學生提出想問的問題，再由學生投票決定18個希望被回答的問題。問題會分配在第9-16週由同學分組回答，每週回答二題，同學報告之後再由老師補充相關資料。希望能藉由這種互動的方式，瞭解學生想知道的問題是什麼，同時也會開放課堂討論，達到教學相長的目的。● 教學進度(Syllabus)1. Week 8第八問：期中考9.	Week 9-16 第九到十六問：第三周時請每個同學提出想問的問題一題，並開投票決定要回答那些問題，由同學分組每週回答四題，並開放大家討論。● 成績考核(Evaluation)1. 出席 10% 2. 課堂討論與分組回饋單 20%3. 期中考試　35%4. 口頭報告  35% ● 可連結之網頁位址 相關網頁(Personal Website)eeclass數位學習平台基於透明與負責任的原則，本課程鼓勵學生利用AI進行協作或互學，以提升本門課產出品質。根據本校公布之「大學教育場域AI協作、共學與素養培養指引」，本門課程採取有條件開放，以下說明如何使用生成式AI於課程產出學生須於課堂作業或報告中的「標題頁註腳」或「引用文獻後」簡要說明如何使用生成式AI進行議題發想、文句潤飾或結構參考等使用方式。若經查核使用卻無在作業或報告中標明，教師、學校或相關單位有權重新針對作業或報告重新評分或不予計分。本門課授課教材或學習資料若有引用自生成式AI，教師也將在投影片或口頭標注。修讀本課程之學生於選課時視為同意以上倫理聲明。

course.titleZh: 跨領域學術英文分析與學習
course.titleEn: Interdisciplinary Academic English Analysis and Learning
course.syllabusSource: 清大官方課程系統大綱（由 NTHUMods 公開索引整理）
course.description:
「跨領域學術英文分析與學習」為協助大學部學生銜接研究所學習而設計，適合大二至大四、已開始接觸專題研究或對未來研
究發展有興趣之學生修習。隨著研究歷程的推進，學生在學術文獻閱讀、研究理解與學術寫作表達方面，對英文能力的需求日
益提升。本課程旨在系統性地培養學生之學術英文閱讀與分析能力，協助其建立紮實基礎，以利未來研究所階段之學習與研究
發展。
本課程選用教材涵蓋多元學術領域，透過跨領域學術文本的閱讀、解析與比較，引導學生理解不同學科之研究取向、論證邏輯
與共通的學術論述結構。藉由此一學習歷程，學生不僅能有效提升學術英文理解與表達能力，亦能在語文學習的同時，逐步拓
展其跨領域學術視野，培養理解不同研究文化與思維方式的能力。
在全球化與跨國科研合作日益頻繁的趨勢下，具備良好的學術英文閱讀、分析與溝通能力，已成為清華大學學生及臺灣未來科
研人才不可或缺的核心素養。本課程期望協助學生及早建立跨領域學術英文能力，使其在未來參與國際學術交流、研究合作與
科學溝通時，能清楚表達研究理念、理解多元學術觀點，並在國際舞台上展現清華大學與臺灣科研社群的學術實力與影響力。

course.description:
本課程以「音樂、健康科技與表演藝術醫學」為核心，帶領學生從實證醫學基礎出發，學習如何將音樂介入、健康照護與生理量
測應用於高齡者照護與表演藝術健康促進。課程前半部介紹實證醫學、學術海報製作、音樂健康照護、音樂介入成效評估，以及
表演藝術醫學的基本概念與研究典範；後半部則進一步探討常用生理量測技術，包括IMU、關節活動度、姿勢動作分析、表面肌電
圖與肌肉負荷分析，並延伸至智慧健康照護系統、生理訊號資料應用、多模態資料與AI輔助照護系統設計。課程採講授、案例討
論、分組主題分享與期末海報競賽並行，培養學生跨領域整合、實證分析、研究表達與健康科技應用能力，期望學生能以音樂與
科技為媒介，提出具創新性與實務價值的健康促進方案。

course.prerequisites:
擋修對象 : 全校

course.syllabusSource: 清大官方課程系統大綱（由 NTHUMods 公開索引整理）
course.description:
精準醫療(Precision Medicine)的概念已從研究的範疇進入臨床實務中，從細胞治療、個人的健康狀況風險分析、疾病早
期偵測與診斷、癌症存活率評估、到複雜疾病的個人化治療計畫、都開始進入目前的醫療體系中。目前在衛服部也已開始給
付高通量定序的基因檢測，醫院端也開始提供相關的基因檢測或治療策略，但對大多數的人，甚至是生命科學的相關研究人
員對大部分基因檢測的內涵與應用也並不是很清楚。在細胞治療的領域，隨著再生醫療法案的建立與執行，幹細胞的回輸漸
漸普及，如NK細胞、CIK細胞、DC細胞、關節幹細胞治療等，已有相當多的實例證實其功效性。另外外泌體在化妝品產業的應
用，或將來回輸人體的治療策略，也正蓬勃發展，這些新的技術與策略都是現今學生必要了解的新知。所以本課程將介紹基
因檢測與細胞治療在精準醫療時代的重要性及應用範圍，熟悉基因檢測與細胞治療的原理與將來的應用，提供學生了解精準
醫療的發展方向。
course.objectives: Course keywords: 精準醫療、基因檢測、高通量定序、細胞治療、外泌體、Precision Medicine、Genetic testing、Next generation sequencing、Cell Therapy、Exosome      一、課程說明: 介紹細胞治療與基因檢測在精準醫療時代的重要性，熟悉基細胞治療與基因檢測的原理與將來的應用，並介紹基因大數據相關資料庫與AI技術如何應用在基因與疾病間關聯性的分析，提供學生了解現代精準醫療的發展方向。二、指定用書	本課程將以教師講義與期刊或其他參考資料為主。三、參考書籍	課堂指定相關論文四、教學方式	口頭授課與互動討論為主，並會邀請產業人士來演講授課，                了解精準醫學與基因檢測的未來發展。五、教學進度(課程主題) (A)、精準醫療與基因體學概論 (B)、基因檢測技術與檢測試劑的發展與應用(C)、基因檢測在大健康產業的應用(D)、序列多形性與全基因組疾病關聯分析(E)、基因與疾病資料庫介紹 (F)、基因檢測實驗室認證與法規 (G)、基因檢測在癌症治療的應用(H)、基因檢測在臨床藥物的應用(I)、精準醫療的商品行銷策略(J)、細胞治療與法規(K)、外泌體的理論與臨床應用 (L)、大數據資料在基因檢測的應用六、成績考核	    課堂參與: 包含出席,討論與課後作業(40%)。另外共需繳交兩次報告，             期中報告(佔30%)以及期末報告(佔30%)。七、可連結之網頁位址(相關網頁)	    https://eeclass.nthu.edu.tw/八、AI 使用規則    禁止使用, 請自行撰寫心得報告

course.description:
隨著高通量定序技術在臨床的應用，透過基因數據資料來了解疾病發生風險、發展與治療策略選擇的應用也越來廣泛。如何正確
的解讀基因數據的結果並對病人及家屬有詳細的說明也越顯重要。然而，目前具備基因諮詢能力的人才非常缺乏。本課程主要是
在介紹基因諮詢之基本概念與應用，目標在於培育能理解並正確解讀基因數據資料及正確說明的基因諮詢人才。面對將來基因醫
學的快速發展，本課程可訓練學生具備基本的基因數據解讀和基因諮詢相關能力，並可在將來取得基因諮詢師的專業認證，提升
其就業的能力。本課程是與國家衛生研究院師資共同開設，會邀請相關領域的專家參與授課。

course.description:
臺灣是一個海島，由海洋展開的內外連結應是社會經濟發展根基。本課程的安排是按照主題區分，從臺灣的海洋環境結構、國家
與海岸治理、漁業發展、漁村共同體、商業網絡、宗教信仰、飲食文化、洋行、商人、米糖經濟、帝國學知、對外貿易、冷戰與

究的能力。

tools of management accounting, but also to promote their understanding of the dramatic ways in which

course.description:
This is the first course in the two-semester undergraduate sequence of Public Finance.  Public Finance 
is the branch of economics that studies the role of the public sector in the economy, and the approach 
is primarily based on microeconomics.  In this semester, we will have a focus on the expenditure 
side of 
public finance.  The course will begin with an introduction to the public sector and basic economic 
tools, followed by the economic reasons and outcomes of government interventions.  We will then look at 
what the public sector actually does using examples from the expenditure policies in the United States 
and in Taiwan, and how it affects individual decision-making and welfare.  This course is offered in 
English.

course.description:
數理經濟學是一門經濟學的分支，其目的在為經濟分析提供嚴謹的架構，尤其當經濟理論過於複雜而超過口語或圖形的表達範圍時，數理經濟學提供分析的工具。除了在經濟理論的發展中發揮了關鍵的作用，數理經濟學也普遍應用於經濟學的各個領域，提供數學工具對經濟現象進行建模及分析，進而發展出明確且可檢驗的理論假說。

經濟系的同學在大二的個體經濟學都上過微積分和個經，對微積分、靜態優化等應該都不陌生。本門課將建立在這個基礎上，介紹經濟學常用的數學工具，如線性代數、多變數微積分、凸性規劃等，及其在個體經濟學的應用。

course.description:
在全球化的潮流下，近30年來世界各國紛紛降低貿易障礙，加速商品貿易的流量。此外，國際間生產分工的方式，已從過去
產品之間的分工，逐漸轉為生產同一種商品在不同製程上的分工。在貿易自由化與國際分工的趨勢下，加速商品、人才與資
金的跨國移動，提升國家與國家間生產活動的關聯性。透過國際貿易，各國可專注於本國較具生產優勢的商品，在國際市場
換取本國生產成本較高的商品，進而提升本國的生產效率與福利。雖然自由貿易可提升一國福利，但同時也可能對一國所得
分配造成不均度惡化。因此，各國政府在制定貿易相關政策時多受到許多爭議。
本課程主要介紹當前國際貿易理論模型，分析國家間為何會進行貿易，以及自由貿易與貿易政策(如:關稅)下對一國福利的影
響，期望學生未來能對國貿相關議題有初步認識及相關分析能力。

Since the publication of Varian (2014), people have been believing that machine learning uses data 
to 
predict some variable as a function of other variables, while econometrics use statistical methods 
for 
prediction, inference, and causal modeling of economic relationships.  However, nowadays some tend 
to 
believe that machine learning is the new generation nonparametric statistical and econometric 
methods, 
branded as machine learning (Chernozhukov et al. 2017). While academically rigorous theorems are 
much 
appreciated, they are not the focus of this course. Instead, this course starts with basic concepts 
of 
machine learning and econometrics; and ends with procedural computer codes.  Students are required 
to be 
familiar with at least one software such as Python, R or C++.

This course introduces students to major themes in political economy, with a focus on how political 
institutions, market mechanisms, state capacity, interest groups, public values, and distributional 
conflicts influence economic policy and development outcomes. Rather than treating policies as purely 
technical solutions, the course asks why certain policies are adopted, who benefits from them, who 
bears their costs, and why seemingly efficient or fair policies often fail in practice. The first half 
of the course introduces core analytical tools in political economy, including institutions, 
collective action, voting, redistribution, political incentives, and state capacity. The second half 
applies these tools to contemporary debates on market society, inequality, meritocracy, populism, and 
AI governance.

course.description:
This course introduces the basic theories and the implementations of logic circuits and digital 
systems. We will start with the topics of number systems and Boolean algebra, which are fundamental to 
all digital systems, followed by the optimization, storage elements such as flip flops, and sequential 
circuits. With both combinational logic and sequential circuits, we will discuss the design of 
registers, counters, memory as well as programmable devices.

course.description:
Talk Like a Pro: Effective Presentation Skills is an interactive online course hosted on Future 
Learn that develops strategic presentation and public speaking skills for academic and professional 
contexts. The course adopts a step-based microlearning design integrating short video lectures, 
guided reflection, embedded quizzes, and discussion-based activities.

Learners explore how to analyze audience and purpose, structure compelling content, enhance delivery 
techniques, manage Q&A sessions, and build a confident speaker mindset. Through task-based 
assignments and peer interaction, participants apply key concepts to their own presentation topics, 
progressively refining both content and delivery. By the end of the course, learners will have 
developed practical tools to design, deliver, and evaluate presentations with clarity, engagement, 
and professional impact.

course.objectives: Course keywords: introduction to programming, Python language, computer science, structured language, modules      Course DescriptionThis course introduces fundamental programming concepts in the Python language and related environment.  Fundamental concepts include overview of computer systems, Python environment setup, Python language overview, command line interface, numbers, string formatting, sequences, dictionaries and sets, control flow, exception, file, function, recursion, object orientation, inheritance, polymorphism, and modules.  The programming environment will be primarily text-based in Unix environment, although graphical user interface  (IDLE) and web-based (Jupyter) will also be demonstrated.  Teaching MethodAsynchronous remote instruction, 2 hours of recorded lecture (Mandarin with English captions) quiz every other week.  Register your NTHU GAPP account on this form so you will be granted access to view recorded lectures on  NTHU MOOC.1. "Asynchronous Remote Instruction" (非同步遠距教學)    View Recorded lectures on NTHU MOOC -- don't fall behind!!    14 weeks of materials, about 2 hours per week, plus supplemental material2. In person (physical attendance required)    a.  Quiz every two weeks starting week 3 in instructional computing laboratories        Two parts: written (筆試) + programming (上機考: Online Judge)    b. (New for Fall 2026) Group Discussion and project checkpoint in the other slots Individually arranged with TA and classmates during T5, T6, or R5Textbooks- None required, but the instructor is making available an e-book based on the slides and bilingual captions.- supplemental materials on type hint, match-case statements, walrus operator, References- Paul Deitel, Harvey Deitel, Intro to Python for Computer Science and Data Science: Learning to Program with AI, Big Data and the Cloud, Global Edition, Pearson Education Limited, 2022. ISBN 10: 1-292-36490-4; ISBN-13: 978-1-292-36490-2.- Python website, www.python.orgScheduleWeek 1 - introduction, environment setupWeek 2 - tour of PythonWeek 3 - basic types, command-line applicationWeek 4 - command-line application (cont'd), stringsWeek 5 - collections: sequence (list, tuple), set, dictWeek 6 - control constructs: if, while, forWeek 7 - exceptions, filesWeek 8 - functionsWeek 9 - recursion, functional programmingWeek 10 - object-oriented programming part 1: class, methodWeek 11 - object-oriented programming part 2: inheritance, operator overloadingWeek 12 - generators, iteratorsWeek 13 - standard library part 1: data types, itertoolsWeek 14 - standard library part 2: regular expressions, TkinterAI Policy:The AI policy is stated for each specific assignment.  In general, you should save all of your AI dialogs if the TA asks.  You are not allowed to copy and paste the problem statement and ask AI to do the work for you. A way to use AI is to ask it to explain or clarify concepts. Evaluation 30% - assignments (programming project, one-on-one grading)  作業 (程式，一對一評分), 30% - quizzes (every two weeks, written and OJ) 小考 (每兩週一次，筆試和上機考)35% - final exam (also written and OJ)  期末考 (同樣是筆試和上機考)5% - discretionary (TA impression)  斟酌分 (助教印象分)Note that the discretionary point is at the discretion of the TA. course.description:
This mandatory course provides a comprehensive foundation for the mathematical analysis of signals and systems, which is essential for fields such as signal processing, communications, optics, and control. The curriculum focuses on the properties and interactions of continuous-time and discrete-time signals within linear time-invariant (LTI) systems.  Students will master fundamental mathematical operations and transforms used to characterize deterministic signals and system behavior. 
Key topics include:  Convolution; Fourier Series and Fourier Transforms (Continuous and Discrete);  Sampling Theory; Laplace Transforms and z-Transforms. By combining theoretical rigor with practical examples, the course aims to consolidate the analytical skills necessary to solve complex engineering problems in both the time and frequency domains.
course.objectives: Course keywords: Linear Time-Invariant (LTI) Systems, Convolution, Fourier Analysis (Fourier Series and Fourier Transform), Laplace Transform, z-Transform, Sampling      Detailed Course Syllabus Course Description: This mandatory course is designed to consolidate the mathematical foundations essential for fields such as signal processing, communications, optics, and control. The curriculum focuses on the analysis of continuous-time and discrete-time deterministic signals and linear time-invariant (LTI) systems. Students will learn various analysis methods, including convolution, Fourier series, Fourier transforms, Laplace transforms, and z-transforms, through both theoretical frameworks and practical examples.  Text Books: Oppenheim, Willsky, with Nawab, Signals and Systems, 2nd Ed., Pearson (2014).  Teaching Methods: Lectures conducted in English.  Questions are welcome in both English and Chinese.  Course materials and notes are available on the school's eeclass platform.  Course Schedule:1. 訊號與系統的基本概念 (Fundamentals of Signals and Systems)2. 線性非時變系統 (Linear Time-Invariant Systems)3. 週期性訊號的傅立葉級數表示法 (Fourier Series Representation of Periodic Signals)4. 連續時間傅立葉轉換 (The Continuous-Time Fourier Transform)5. 離散時間傅立葉轉換(The Discrete-Time Fourier Transform)6. 訊號與系統之時域與頻域特性 (Time and Frequency Characterization of Signals and Systems) : (如果學期時間允許)7. 取樣 (Sampling)8. 拉普拉斯轉換 (The Laplace Transform)9. Z-轉換 (The z-Transform) Evaluation:Quiz in the class  20% Midterm	40%Final	40% ##補充說明: 欲加簽者請不用提前寄信給授課老師，加退選期間視教室容量及選課人數優先加簽電機系學生, 第二優先為電資班大三大四同學, 請有興趣加簽的同學務必第一堂課到課堂填寫加簽單. course.description:
近年來全球資通訊與網路及AI等科技快速發展，以及自2020年起Covid-19新冠疫情席捲全球，加上中美科技與貿易戰、俄烏戰爭
以及美伊戰爭等地緣政治劇烈變動與2050淨零碳排等多重因素之衝擊，世界經濟與產業進入高速蛻變的時代。這不僅影響人類的生
活型態與消費者行為，科技產業的發展生態體系及地緣政治下的市場遊戲規則也產生革命性的劇烈變化，例如：5G、人工智慧、
ChatGPT、DeepSeek、大數據、數位轉型、生醫、長照、材料、綠能、無人載具及智慧型機器人等各領域皆創造出很多嶄新的產
品、服務與商業模式等。本課程特別邀請國內各科技與產業領域頂尖專家，以講座方式介紹最新各領域發展趨勢及台灣產業發展的

course.description:
眾所週知，世界已經邁向了服務經濟的時代。「服務」存在人類社會遠在所謂的「服務業」的產業
分類。但究竟「服務」是什麼？而當IBM於2004年倡導所謂的「服務科學」，或者後來加上工程與
管理，統稱「服務科學工程與管理」(Service Science, Management, and Engineering, 
SSME)。近年來，在原有的SSME外加上Design，成為現在一般談及服務科學時，以SSMED來描述
它。究竟其內涵與實質內容為何？究竟服務科學的範圍與議題為何？服務科學與現有的學術與實務
領域有何關聯？如何將服務科學的理論應用於實務上？實務上的議題與需求如何來成為服務科學的
研究內容與貢獻？本課程的課程內容規劃即在滿足大家對服務科學的好奇心。同時也希望學生能勇
敢地探索此一新的領域，成為服務科學發展學術與實務社群的生力軍。
本課程的目標簡述如下：
1. 學生能完整定義服務科學的內涵與範疇。
2. 學生能應用服務體驗設計，進行服務設計。
3. 學生能分析與規劃服務價值網絡以提供服務價值。
4. 學生能針對不同的產業提出創新的服務模式。
5. 學生能指出重要的服務科學相關的重要議題，進行研究。
本課程的內容與教學具有以下的特色：
1. 理論與實務並重；
2. 講授與個案教學

What is service science?2. Service science, the revolution vs. the evolution?3. Service economy, where does the service value come from?4. Service innovation, what can be counted as service innovation?二、服務體驗設計1. How do you know potential customers’ needs?2. Methods for service design and engineering3. New service development (NSD)4. New service development project management.三、服務價值網絡1. How to articulate segmented business processes as a value added service network?2. How to add service value to products?四、資訊科技與服務科學1. IT service2. Service-oriented Architecture (SOA)3. Cloud computing and service四、服務科學與服務開放創新1. Service open innovation2. Service experimentation3. Service quality 4. Service globalization評分要點：課程參與：50%  專案：50%

course.description:
本課程旨在培養和提升EMBA/MBA學生的領導力，重點在於實用性，探討如何在瞬息萬變的數位化AI商業環境中，將領導力、
權力與政治技巧有效應用於各類組織中 （特別是受傳統文化影響而又急需創新和創業的企業）促進企業成長，個人事業成功
和生活美滿。
在任何組織中，不論其規模或性質，都存在領導力實踐與權力運用的交互作用。隨著外界環境變化，這種互動/博弈過程也在
變化，其結果直接影響組織績效與個人職涯發展。而當前快速變動的數位化商業環境中，人工智慧（AI）提升了資訊透明
度、資料可得性與決策速度。本課程不以AI為主軸，而是適度結合 AI 所帶來的「眼光延伸」與「策略敏捷化」，協助學生理
解在領導力實踐，權力運用在公司政治要素中，哪些能力將因數位工具被放大，哪些則更加依賴領導者的人格、價值與判
斷。
AI 時代的領導者最重要的能力仍然是願景、策略判斷、贏得人心、文化建設與執行力。科技提高效率，但無法取代領導
者的洞察力、勇氣、道德框架與激勵人心的力量。因此，本課程將在原有領導力實踐，權力運用在公司政治的基礎上，加入
「AI 帶來的環境變化」作為參考視角，使學生更能以現代化的方式理解傳統領導力的深度意義。

course.description: 本課程主要介紹公司治理相關的國內外議題以及台灣之公司法制。
course.objectives: Course keywords: 公司法,公司治理,證券市場,證券交易法,企業併購      一、課程說明：本課程主要介紹台灣公司法制以及公司治理相關的國內外議題。公司法制(corporate law system)，係指容許公司(主要是股份有限公司)運作之法制環境(institutional ecology)。自我國法典面而言，其乃以公司法與證券交易法為核心；其他較外環之配套法規包括例如：金融法規、民事法、刑事法、企業併購法、與投資者保護有關之程序法規(如代表訴訟、團體訴訟等機制)，亦包含相關主管機關(如經濟部、金管會、證交所、櫃買中心)公布之規範。課程安排上，本課程將重點討論公司治理運作之基本原則、台灣公司法制之基本法律架構、以及股東與管理階層間之法律關係。再者，本課程亦將邀請法律實務界人士就公司治理法制之特定熱門議題到課堂上演講，以利學員在理論與實務上的融會。二、參考書籍（暫定）：教師會事先準備指定閱讀資料，並於課堂上發給每位學員。三、教學方式：本課程係以「討論」為主，故希望學員能積極參與課堂討論。每堂課在教師說明當次討論主題之背景後，即進入課堂討論。教師期待每位學員能主動地積極參與討論，並與其他學員分享閱讀指定資料之心得或其他個人研究觀察之想法。應注意者，學員將分組且推選出組長。四、教學進度（暫定）：(1) 公司治理之序曲(2) 電影與公司治理(3) 公司治理與法律的基礎概念(4) 投保中心、商業法院與公司治理(5) ESG永續策略與挑戰(6) 董事會與獨立董事(7) 經營權爭奪與與公司治理五、成績考核（暫定）：(1) 課程參與(含分組上台報告與課堂上的主動發言)：70%。(2) 出席率：30%。

In addition to a focus of corporate finance and the functions of the security market, this course will, from time to time, make comparison between the U.S. and Taiwanese models of corporate law, corporate governance, while looking into emerging trends in business sustainability or ESG (environmental, social & corporate governance). 2. References:The course materials are those to be assigned and distributed to students bit by bit in class.3. Moreover, active and significant student participation in class discussion is required.4. course.description:
本課程旨在引導學生掌握進行跨領域研究所需的核心方法與學術寫作能力，涵蓋從研究設計、資料蒐集到成果撰寫的完整研究流程，並透過
實作經驗逐步深化理解與應用。學生將學習如何依據具體問題與情境背景，選擇與整合適切的研究策略，提出具備實證基礎的創新解方。課
程前半段聚焦於研究設計與方法論建構，內容涵蓋研究問題的界定、資料蒐集與分析策略、跨領域合作的實務挑戰，以及研究倫理與學術責
任。透過案例分析與小組討論，學生將培養實務敏感度，並強化與異質專業背景研究者協作的能力。後半段則專注於科技論文撰寫技巧，依
序涵蓋文獻綜述撰寫、研究方法與結果呈現、討論與結論發展，進一步延伸至標題設計與摘要撰寫。課程將寫作視為研究思維發展與深化的
關鍵歷程，透過書寫的過程，學生將學習如何釐清問題意識、反思研究決策、修正論述方向，進而強化其跨領域整合與溝通能力。學生將透
過漸進式的寫作演練與回饋修正，有系統地提升論文的結構邏輯、語言表達與學術溝通力，最終能完整表達其研究成果，並與相關領域進行
有效交流。

course.description:
針對企業個案進行分析討論，協助同學了解企業個案分析之方法。 
進行方式,模擬練習、評論與企業個案分析。學生有機會深入研究實際企業個案，應用經濟學工具進行深度分析，了解商業決
策的複雜性。 透過對實例的討論，學生將學會如何從經濟學角度全面評估企業策略。 這門課程旨在培養學生在實際商業環
境中運用經濟學原理進行深度分析的能力，使他們能夠更全面、更深入地理解並應對現代企業面臨的各種挑戰。
以資本預算、投資與購併、企業價值評估與公司治理三個範疇，思考如何創造公司價值並顧及利害關係人的權益。本課程將以
課堂討?809;及個案教學方式，幫助學生將財務決策觀?907;導入於實際企業經營中，達到學以致用，提升自身價值與企業價值。包含
三部分：
一、回顧與建立財管知識，並運用這些知識進行公司理財決策。（投資決策、融資決策與股利決策）
二、運用財管與公司理財的知識，分析解讀財務個案。
三、提升計算能力，解決財務問題。計算IRR、NPV、Beta與進行資本預算等。上課方式先導讀個案，介紹財務觀念與解決方
法，最後討論個案與制訂決策。

course.description:

course.description:
本課程旨在給學生對於人工神經網路的理論基礎和應用已經在軟硬體上的實現有概略的介紹，它將討論典型的主題，包括從統計學習理論
(statistical learning theory)的觀點，嚴謹的討論學習的統計基礎，例如神經網絡的訓練(training)和測試(testing)、VC 維度(VC dimension)和模
型複雜性 (model complexity)、正則化(regularization)作為過度擬合(overfitting)的補救措施。此外，我們還想介紹許多特定的神經網絡模型，包
括基於動態系統 以及其他植根於統計物理學或生物學的模型。例如 Hopfield 模型、玻爾茲曼機(Boltzmann machine)、脈衝神經網絡(spiking 
neural network)， 液態神經網路等等
course.objectives: Course keywords: neural network; artificial intelligence; dynamic system; liquid state machine; Hopfield model; statistical mechanics      本課程旨在給學生對於人工神經網路的理論基礎和應用已經在軟硬體上的實現有概略的介紹，可以視為machine learning 的進階課程，並且與延伸到現在的深度學習(deep learning)，它將討論典型的主題，我們主要想介紹許多基於動態系統(dynamic system)的神經網絡模型，其中一些植根於統計物理學，一些植根於生物學。例如 Hopfield 模型、液體常數神經網絡(liquid time constant neural network); 會教分析神經網路所需的非線性動力系統的數學基礎和code 的實例。也會教授深度學習的幾種神經網路，例如卷積神經網路（convolution neural network)，循環神經網路 (recurrent neural network)課程內容：1.Introduction 2. Learning process; The perceptron; Least-mean square algorithm; Multilayer perceptron(MLP); universal approximation theorem3. Deep neural network with ReLu activation and convolution neural network for computer vision;  gradient descent4. dyanamic system; phase plane analysis; stability analysis; Euler method, RK method5. Hopfield model; associate memory; Neural network rooted in statistical physics6. Recurrent neural network, long term and short term memory(LSTM)7. other special topics:  liquid time constant recurrent neural network; network motif; genetic algorithm擬用教科書或參考書：教科書： 1. Simon Haykin, Neural network and learning machines 3rd edition2.Deep Learning. by Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio and Aaron Courville. Pub date: November 18, 2016, MIT Press.. 3. Simon Prince, Understanding deep learning. Summit Valley Press, 2023.成績考核 (Evaluation)考試 （76%）作業(24%)參考書：1.  Aurelien Geron, Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn, Keras, and TensorFlow, 2nd Edition, OReilly, 2019.2. Steven Strogatz, Non linear dynamics and chaos, 2nd edition, CRC Press.採用下列何項 AI 使用規則 (Indicate which of the following options you use to manage student use of the AI)禁止使用，請註明相關的監管機制 Prohibited use; please specify relevant oversight there will be some random checking of usage of AI tool such as ChapGPT.Our course is the core of AI course so basically, all the homework design will be aimed to to outsmart the commercial AI tool.keywords: machine learning, artificial intelligence, artificial neural network, hopfield model, recurrent neural network

course.description:
The promise of better performance, lower cost, and miniaturization of sensor and actuator systems has 
motivated growth in the field of MicroElectroMechanical Systems (MEMS). MEMS technology has found broad 
applications in inertial sensing, data storage, micromanipulation, optical communication, biochemical 
analysis, and microfluidic systems. This course will initially focus on fundamental MEMS topics, 
including microfabrication, micromechanical/bio/chemical sensors, and actuators. Additionally, I will 
introduce concepts in mechanics of materials, structural dynamics, and noise, all of which are crucial 
for understanding and implementing micromechanical sensors. More advanced subjects, such as MEMS 
system-level design methodology and MEMS control, may be introduced towards the end of the semester.
course.objectives: Course keywords: 微機電系統、微感測器、微致動器、感測電路、MEMS, microsensors, microactuators, sensing circuits.       一、課程說明(Course Description)MEMS (Microelectromechanical Systems) technology facilitates the miniaturization of bio-electro-mechanical devices and systems, allowing for the integration of various components onto a single chip. This results in numerous benefits, such as increased functionality, reduced size and cost, improved performance, and enhanced reliability. MEMS technology is widely applicable across various industries, including automotive, aerospace, biomedical, consumer electronics, and telecommunications. To foster interdisciplinary learning in this field, this course will explore a broad spectrum of topics, including microfabrication, micromechanical and biochemical sensors, actuation mechanisms, static and dynamic mechanical analysis, noise analysis, and sensor readout design.二、指定用書(Text Books)class handouts 三、參考書籍(References)四、教學方式(Teaching Method)Powerpoint presentation and blackboard五、教學進度(Syllabus)(1) Introduction(2) Microfabrication(3) Sensing Mechanisms(4) Sensing circuits(5) Micromechanical/Physical Sensors(6) Electrostatic Actuation(7) Mechanics of Material(8) Noise Analysis(9) Dynamics of Mechanical Structures(10) Bio/Chemical Sensors 六、成績考核(Evaluation)Homework + Paper study + Lab (20%)Final exam (30%)Project I: accelerometers (25%)Project II: topic of student's own choice (25%)For Project II, you are required to choose a topic different from Project I. In your final presentation, you should justify your choice of topic, conduct a thorough literature review (using journal papers exclusively), and clearly explain the design, analysis, and key features of the research covered in these papers.報告撰寫： 報告撰寫需以參考期刊為主，以整段或顯著地copy and paste他人文章則是不允許的，必須研讀內容後以自己的方式寫出自己的報告。 七、可連結之網頁位址eeclass數位學習平台

course.description:
This course provides an in-depth study of semiconductor memory technologies and VLSI memory cell 
design. Through lectures, homework assignments, and design-oriented projects, students will learn the 
operating principles, cell structures, fabrication processes, layout considerations, and integration 
technologies of major semiconductor memories, including DRAM, SRAM, and Flash memory. The course 
emphasizes both device-level and circuit-level understanding of memory cells and arrays. Topics 
include charge-storage mechanisms, read/write operations, cell layout, process integration, sense-
amplifier concepts, memory architecture, and reliability considerations. Students may also practice 
cell design, simulation, characterization, and optimization using TCAD or SPICE based approaches.

course.description:
With this class you start a systematic sequence of courses that are going to present subjects which 
distinguish a nuclear engineer from other engineering fields.  On a simple minded level, the 
differences between the various engineering disciplines can be readily described.  Thus, as you 
know, chemical engineers deal with chemical process, electrical engineers with electricity, civil 
engineers with structures and so on.  In this simple classification scheme, the domain of nuclear 
engineers encompasses neutrons, nuclear reactors and radiation processes.  However, reality is in 
fact quite a bit more complicated.  You will find that a nuclear engineer you will have to learn not 
just about neutron interactions with matter, but also about hear transfer, fluid flow, chemical 
processes and even a little about metrologhy. In practice, the differences between the engineering 
disciplines turn out to be differences of emphasis rather than substance.

course.description: 學習「程式語言」的主要目的在於如何利用這個功能強大且具有彈性的工具來協助你解決問題，特別是一些重複性高或牽涉複雜計算的工作。我們可以利用程式語言來控制電腦的運作，達到自動化的處理以大幅增加工作效率，這也是本課程的目標。了解電腦工作的原理與如何建立有效的演算法/解題方案(Algorithm)是程式設計最重要的核心，打好基礎以利未來持續自我學習相關的新技術。
course.objectives: Course keywords: 電腦(Computer)、程式(Programming)、計算(Computation)、邏輯(Logic)、解題方案(Algorithm)      一、課程名稱：程式語言（Programming Languages）二、授課教師：工科系/核工所 許榮鈞（rjsheu@mx.nthu.edu.tw）三、教學方式：3學分(每週上課三小時)四、課程說明：如何充分利用並發揮電腦的運算能力？你應該了解電腦架構與運作基礎，學習透過數學與邏輯思考去設計解題步驟，再利用程式語言(控制電腦執行的語法)來實現你的想法!這也是本課程的設計目的，學習利用程式語言來協助你解決問題，特別是一些重複性高或牽涉到複雜計算的工作。我們可以利用程式語言來控制電腦的運作，達到自動化的處理流程，可以大幅增進工作效率並減少人工錯誤。了解電腦工作的原理與如何建立有效的演算法/解題方案(Algorithm)是程式設計最重要的核心，打好基礎以利未來持續自我學習、與時俱進。本課程主要以C語言為例，介紹程式設計的基本概念，包括：變數、運算子、流程控制、函數、陣列、指標、字串、結構、輸入/輸出與檔案處理。上課內容同時搭配介紹Python直譯式程式語言，因其簡潔易學特性作為編譯式C語言學習的比較，課堂上所有案例都有C與Python程式碼可供學生對照學習。另外，許多工程領域科學計算的主要程式還是使用FORTRAN語言，若有時間期末我們也會提及FORTRAN與其上述語言的比較。上課期間不時將簡介一些資料結構與陣列排序等重要概念，以利同學未來持續深入程式設計的應用領域。課程內容章節如下：1.	Introduction to Computers and C2.	Introduction to C Programming3.	Structured Program Development in C4.	C Program Control5.	C Functions6.	C Arrays7.	Python Basics and Data Structures8.	C Pointers9.	C Characters and Strings10.	C Structures and Enumerations11.	C File Processing12.	C Data Structures13.	Computer-Science Thinking: Sorting Algorithms and Big O14.	Fortran, C/C++, and Python for Scientific Computing五、指定用書 (Textbook)1.	Paul Deitel and Harvey Deitel, “C How to Program”, 6th/7th/8th/9th Edition, Prentice Hall (2009/2012/2016/2022)2.	A.B. Downey, “Think Python: How to Think Like a Computer Scientist”, 2nd Edition, O'Reilly Media (2015)六、成績考核1.	Midterm	        (40%)上機考試(可攜帶教科書參考)2.	Final		(40%)上機考試(可攜帶教科書參考)3.	Homework/Quiz	(20%)註：本課程鼓勵學生使用AI協作或學習參考，但還是要自己多思考並多練習，因為上機考試沒有AI也沒有網路，只能帶教科書(C How to Program)或一本類似的C語言書籍當參考。

course.description:
The objective of this course is to develop in the students the ability to analyze and design 
electronic circuits, both analog and digital, discrete and integrated.
course.objectives: Course keywords: Operational Amplifier, Diode, MOSFETs and BJTs       一、課程說明(Course Description)The objective of this course is to develop in the students the ability to analyze and design electronic circuits, both analog and digital, discrete and integrated. The following is the outline of this course:1. Introduction to the basic concepts of electronics. Signals, their frequency spectra, and their analog and digital forms are presented. Amplifiers are introduced as circuit building blocks and their various types and models are studied.2. Introduction to operational amplifiers. Their terminal characteristics, simple applications, and limitations are presented.3. Study of PN junction diode terminal characteristics. Its hierarchy of models and basic circuit applications are discussed.4. Operation principle of MOS field-effect transistor (MOSFET). Study of the device structure and its physical operation are included. In addition, its applications are demonstrated through some circuit examples.5. Operation principle of bipolar junction transistor (BJT). Device physics will be described and circuit models for transistor operation in different modes will be developed and utilized in the analysis and design of circuit. 二、指定用書(Text Books)Sedra/Smith, "Microelectronic Circuits," Oxfrod, 6/7/8th Ed. 三、參考書籍(References)Rashid, "Microelectronic Circuits: Analysis and Design," Cengage, 3rd Ed. Neaman,"Electronic Circuit Analysis And Design," Irwin. 四、教學方式(Teaching Method)Powerpoint files from the course website. 五、教學進度(Syllabus)1. Introduction to electronics: 1 week2. Operational Amplifier: 3 weeks3. Diodes and related circuits: 3 weeks.4. BJT Transisotrs: 4 weeks.5. MOs Transistors: 5 weeks. 六、成績考核(Evaluation)Homework:   10%Midterm I:  30%Midterm II  30%Final:      30% 七、可連結之網頁位址http://greenelectronics.wixsite.com/yung-hsien-wu

course.description:
In this course, you will learn about the basic principles of circuit operation in a practical, 
real-world laboratory setting. You will work both with discrete components such as resistors, 
capacitors, diodes, and transistors as well as with integrated components such as operational 
amplifiers. In addition, you will become familiar with the operation of basic electronic test 
equipment (oscilloscopes, function generators, curve tracers, etc.). In addition, you will 
further understand the characteristics of transistors through the semiconductor analyzer which 
is very important for device development. There are 12 experiments this semester. Each class 
will be proceeded by 1-hour principle introduction (at 13:30 in R304) followed by practical 
experiment.

course.description:
The objectives of this course are to (1) provide fundamental background of mass conservation 
, the first and second laws of thermodynamics, and the engineering approach to problem 
solving, and (2) to develop analytic ability in real-world engineering applications using 
work and heat transfer.
course.objectives: Course keywords: Energy system, efficiency, heat, work, cycles      ● 課程說明(Course Description)Conservation of energy; definitions of heat and work for a macroscopic system; system states; first law analysis for closed systems; first law control volume analysis; second law; properties and behavior of pure substances; application to thermodynamic systems operating in a steady state and transient processes; typical power producing cycles and refrigerators. ● 指定用書(Text Books)Thermodynamics: An Engineering Approach by Cengel and Boles 9th Ed● 參考書籍(References)Fundamentals of Thermodynamics by Borgnakke and Sonntag, Wiley 10th Ed ● 教學方式(Teaching Method)Three hours of lecture (English) per week● 教學進度(Syllabus)Introduction and basic concepts (Week #1,2)Properties of pure substances (Week #3,4)First law: energy analysis of closed systems (Week #5,6)Midterm Exam (Week #7)First law: energy analysis of open systems (Week #8,9)Second law (Week #10,11)Midterm Exam (Week #12)Entropy (Week #13-15)Refrigeration and Brayton cycles (Week #16,17)Final Exam (Week #18)● 成績考核(Evaluation)Attendance (bonus)Quizzes: 10%Reports: 15% (5% each for three reports)Midterm exam #1: 25%Midterm exam #2: 25%Final exam: 25%● 可連結之網頁位址 相關網頁(Personal Website)eeclass.nthu.edu.tw

course.description:
This course is structured into two primary sections. Part A focuses on Partial Differential Equations 
(PDEs), emphasizing methods for solving equations frequently encountered in engineering and physics, 
including the wave equation, diffusion equation, and Laplace equation. Part B delves into Complex 
Analysis, offering a comprehensive understanding of analytic functions, differentiation, contour 
integrals, and other critical topics essential for various applications in engineering and physics.
course.objectives: Course keywords: Partial Differential Equations, Separation of Variables, Eigenfunction Expansion, Complex Variables, Cauchy’s Integral Theorem, Residue Theorem.      Textbook:E. Kreyszig, Advanced Engineering Mathematics, 10th or 11th edition. References:Additional relevant textbooks on Engineering Mathematics, Partial Differential Equations, and Complex Variable Analysis.Teaching Method:Primarily consists of slide presentation associated with in-class whiteboard lectures, some pre-course materials would be assigned, and the language used in this course would be 75 % and 25 % in English and Chinese, respectively.________________________________________Course ContentThe course will cover, but is not limited to, the following topics, with adjustments made as necessary based on the progress of the class:Partial Differential Equations:1. 1st Order PDEs2. 2nd Order PDEs3. Classical Wave Equation4. Diffusion Equation5. Laplace EquationComplex Analysis:1. Complex Differentiation and Integration2. Cauchy-Riemann Equations and Cauchy’s Integral Theorem3. Power Series: Taylor and Laurent Series4. Residue Theorem5. Conformal Mapping (Optional)________________________________________Evaluation ComponentsAssessment for the course will be distributed as follows: 1. Homework: 25%2. Midterm Exam: 30%3. Final Exam: 30%4. Participation in Class Activities: 15%________________________________________Note: This course does not involve the use of AI technologies. Please respect intellectual property rights; do not use illegal copies of textbooks.本課程無涉及AI使用

utilization in engineering materials and processes. The contents in the first semester are mainly 
focused on the fundamentals of materials science, including (1) crystal structure, (2) defects in 
crystals, (3) diffusion in solid solutions, (4) phase diagrams, and (5) plastic deformation.

course.description:
游離輻射在現代社會有各式各樣不可或缺的應用，使我們不知不覺間享受多種輻射應用所帶來的好處，包括核能發電、醫學診斷與放射治
療、機場安全檢查、工業非破壞性檢測、農產品照射滅菌、考古與探礦的應用等等。另外，輻射更是現代科學探測不可或缺的利器。輻射與
今日人類社會的運作息息相關且不可避免，我們生活環境中亦存在著各種天然輻射於空氣、土壤、建築物、水與食物中，因此值得正確地認
識輻射的特性，了解輻射與物質的作用，以利充分發揮輻射的應用、防止輻射可能引發的傷害、並減少社會大眾對於輻射的誤解。

course.description:
真空技術是現代科技的基石，本課程主要探討真空技術的理論及真空元組件等，內容包括真空技術的基礎理論、各式真空
幫浦的介紹、各類真空元件及材料、真空系統的設計組裝、真空測漏，以及真空度量與檢校。從民生相關的食品包裝、眼
鏡鍍膜、電視映像管，到高科技產業中的光電元件與半導體製程、尖端的材料分析儀器，甚至龐大的同步輻射加速器，真
空技術都扮演著重要的核心角色。沒有真空技術就無法享受高品質的現代生活，也不足以從事高科技的研究。真空技術的
進步，不僅可精進儀器設備的性能，並能提升各種產業製程效能及產率，進而實現許多技術的創新。

course.objectives: Course keywords: 學術演講,經驗分享,Seminar Talks, Experience Sharing      1.計分方式：本學期演講至少12次，繳交合格心得報告12次則於期末可獲得基本成績A。【演講心得單】已上傳至eeclass空間，請自行列印填寫。【加分方式】每次與講者互動提問加總成績一級分，累計最高至A+。【心得報告繳交】內容要求：每次心得報告至少100個字以上且與該次演講內容相符。若未達100字簡略的心得報告或心得內容與該次演講內容不相符則扣總成績一級分，並須於助教通知後補交心得單否則當週視為缺交心得單。若無法出席專題演講請照規定辦理請假程序。繳交心得單：請於專題演講後於演講廳內繳交紙本心得單。缺交心得單：每次扣五級分，如此在期末成績為基本分A的情況下，缺交1次即可讓期末成績低於B-，若無因提問加分將於期末不及格，請同學注意。【不及格情況】一次只能交一份心得報告，不可代寫及代交。如發現代寫心得單情形，雙方學期成績零分，並送學務處以考試作弊處置，沒有補救方法。2.請假規則：每次專題演講皆會詢問講者能否錄影，若可錄影則將開放給請假同學觀看，若不可錄影則請請假同學自行參與30分鐘以上之其他演講(實體、同步線上、非同步線上皆可)。無法參加專題演講的同學可在提交假單後，觀看演講錄影或參與其他演講，並於隔週四中午12點前繳交心得單(PDF檔案)至eeclass，若超過期限未繳交心得單則視為缺交心得單，每次扣五級分。(自行參與其他演講僅適用於講者不開放錄影時)請假單請自行在eeclass下載，填寫後給指導老師簽名確認交給助教。分為：1.單次「專題演講請假單」 適用事假、病假等各式情況每次請假申請須於該次演講結束後隔日週四中午12點前提交。單一學期至多可申請三次請假，之後若無正當理由每個超過次數扣期末成績一級分。2.「長期無法實際出席專題演講申請單」適用於預期單一學期將超過三次以上無法實際出席專題演講之學生，僅適用在職生、駐校外單位執行研究之學生等。校內學生不適用。此申請單須於開學後三周內提出申請，逾期不受理。1. Grading Guide：There are at least 12 colloquium talks this semester. You need to submit 12 qualified reports to get a basic final grade of A. 【 Report form】 has been uploaded to the eeclass platform. Please print and fill it out by yourself.【Bonus points】can be acquired through your on-site questions or comments to the speaker → asking each speaker questions deserves one bonus grade point and can be accumulated up to A+.【The submission of report form】Requirements:  Each report needs to contain more than 100 words and be closely related to the talk. A short or sketchy (<100 words) report or the content in the reports is irrelevant to the talk, is regarded as disqualified, and will result in a deduction in the final grade by one grade point. The student must resubmit a qualified report after receiving the notice from the TA; otherwise, the report is considered a missed one that causes a loss of five grade points at the end of the semester. If you cannot attend the colloquium talk in person, please apply for a leave following the rules below.Submission of report forms: Report forms should be submitted as hard copies after the talk inside the lecture hall.Missed report: a missing report causes a deduction by five grade points in the final grade and so on. Therefore, one missed report can result in a final grade below B- without help from the bonus points.【Fail condition】Each person can only submit one report at a time, and you cannot help other students to write or submit their reports. If we find out there are cases of plagiarism, the semester scores of both parties would be zero, and they will be sent to the school affairs office to deal with the act of cheating in the exam, and there is no remedy.2. Leave Rules:Each colloquium talk will inquire whether the speaker allows recording. If recording is permitted, it will be made available for students who apply for leave. If recording is not permitted, students who apply for leave should attend another talk lasting 30 minutes or more (in-person, synchronous online, or asynchronous online are all acceptable). Students who cannot attend the colloquium can submit their leave form, watch the record or participate in another talk, and submit the report form (PDF file only) to eeclass before noon (12 pm) next Thursday after the talk. If the report is submitted after the deadline, it will be considered a missed one and cause a deduction of five grade points in the final grade. (Participation in other talks only applies when the speaker does not allow recording.)The leave form can be downloaded from the eeclass platform. Please fill in the info and get it signed by your advisor before sending it to the TA. There are two types of leave forms:1. For single use: Leave ApplicationApplicable to personal leave, sick leave, etc.Each leave application form should be submitted before noon (12 pm) of the day after the talk.A maximum of three leave applications are allowed for each semester. If your applications exceed the allowed quotas without appropriate reason, each exceeded leave application will result in a deduction in the final grade by one grade point.2. For long term use: Long Term Leave ApplicationApplicable to students who can’t attend the colloquium more than three times. Only applicable to on-job students, students doing research outside the university for a long-term period, etc. Students staying at NTHU cannot apply.This application form must be submitted within three weeks after the start of the semester. Late applications will not be accepted.

course.syllabusSource: 清大官方課程系統大綱（由 NTHUMods 公開索引整理）
course.description:
教授半導體元件設計製程整合與電性及模擬，可以用來預測半導體元件 N16到 N1 的物理特性如：FinFET 電場，電位，電
子濃度分
佈等；以及電學特性如：電流，電壓，臨界電壓，操作頻率，反向器
(inverter)，靜態隨機讀取記憶體(SRAM)等。藉由設計不同結構的半導體元件，分析了解各個半
導體製程與元件的參數對元件特性的影響，並分析其優缺點，如短通道效應，臨界電壓，次臨界
斜率，飽和電流等等。本課程的目的在於使學員了解半導體元件的設計與模擬，擁有使用先進半
導體元件設的基礎理論知識，並結合軟體輔助設計半導體元件的能力，進而能夠模擬分析所設計
的半導體元件的電性特性。本課程主要著重在Silicon CMOS電性模擬，接著是設計2D以及3D的
Silicon CMOS FinFET, , GAAFET, JLFET, CFET, FeFET, INVERTER, SRAM元件，最後將所設計的CMOS元件，
做電性模擬以及解讀模擬的結果。
此課程所教授的設計與模擬技術，在學術研究半導體產業有重大的實用性，並可增進半導體元件物
理與微電子工程所學內容的實踐性。適合從事半導體奈米元件研究開發的碩博士生修習。
course.objectives: Course keywords: 半導體元件設計與模擬 ; MOSFET & FinFET 電場，電位，電子濃度分佈等；以及電學特性如：電流，電壓，臨界電壓，操作頻率，反向器      半導體元件設計與模擬 (Semiconductor devices design and simulation)三學分R234，為工科系5字頭的課研究所的課，因授權軟體關係，限25人選修。選課限制為工科系研究生，半導體學院研究生。 修課限制：由於電腦硬體，與 TCAD 模擬軟體使用執照之數量限制，人數限制為25人。先修課程 (Prerequisites): 半導體元件物理(Semiconductor Physics and Devices)與微電子工程 (Microelectronic Engineering) 研究所程度相當之課程。 教室：工科 404  電腦教室一、課程說明 (Course Description)教授半導體元件設計製程整合與電性及模擬，可以用來預測半導體元件 (N16 to N1) 的物理特性如：MOSFET & FinFET 電場，電位，電子濃度分佈等；以及電學特性如：電流，電壓，臨界電壓，操作頻率，反向器(inverter)，靜態隨機讀取記憶體(SRAM)等。藉由設計不同結構的半導體元件，分析了解各個半導體製程與元件的參數對元件特性的影響，並分析其優缺點，如短通道效應，臨界電壓，次臨界斜率，飽和電流等等。本課程的目的在於使學員了解半導體元件的設計與模擬，擁有使用先進半導體元件設的基礎理論知識，並結合軟體輔助設計半導體元件的能力，進而能夠模擬分析所設計的半導體元件的電性特性。本課程主要著重在Silicon CMOSMOSE 電性模擬，接著是設計2D以及3D 的 Silicon CMOS FinFET, GAAFET, JLFET, CFET, FeFET 元件，最後將所設計的CMOS元件，做電性模擬以及解讀模擬的結果。此課程所教授的設計與模擬技術，在學術研究半導體產業有重大的實用性，並可增進半導體元件物理與微電子工程所學內容的實踐性。適合從事半導體奈米元件研究開發的碩博士生修習。二、指定用書(Text Books)3D TCAD Simulation for CMOS Nanoeletronic DevicesAuthor: Professor Yung-Chun Wu (吳永俊 教授), Dr. Yi-Ruei Jhan (詹易叡 博士)Publisher: Springer; 1st ed. 2018 edition (published at June 21, 2017), Hardcover: 330 pages三、參考書籍(References)Modern Semiconductor Devices for Integrated Circuits, by Chenming Calvin Hu, PEARSON, 2010.2. "Fundamentals of Modern VLSI Devices, 2nd Edition" by Yuan Taur and Tak Ning, 2009.四、教學方式 (Teaching Method)電腦實際操作與投影片教學 (presentation by hand-writing and projection)五、教學進度 (Syllabus)半導體元件設計與模擬介紹2. 半導體元件模擬實驗設計及整合。3. 半導體元件數值分析原理4. 半導體元件之傳輸物理模型5. 半導體元件物性模擬與解讀物性模擬結果6. 2D以及3D Silicon CMOS元件設計7. Silicon CMOS元件模擬與解讀模擬結果8. 3D鰭式電晶體(3D FinFET)的元件設計、模擬及分析9. FinFET Inverter and SRAM 10. GAAFET的元件設計、模擬及分析11. CFET 的元件設計、模擬及分析六、成績考核(Evaluation)50% Homework, 50% final report七、可連結之網頁位址 (not available yet) and Q & AQ1: 這門課與半導體元件物理或微電子工程有何差異?A.: 此課程所教授的設計與模擬技術，在學術研究半導體產業有重大的實用性，並可增進半導體元件物理與微電子工程所學內容的實踐性。所以需具備半導體元件物理(Semiconductor Physics and Devices)與微電子工程的知識，適合從事半導體奈米元件研究開發的碩博士生修習。Q2: 需要有數值模擬的基礎嗎或修過相關的課嗎?A. 非必要，上課會先教相關基礎必要的部分。Q3. 需自備電腦與模擬程式嗎?A. 上課地點為工科系電腦教室，由於數量限制修課人數為25人，模擬程式部分請由個別實驗室，向高速電腦中心申請遠端工作站使用。Q4. 適合大學部學生選修嗎?A. 完全不適合。由於先修課程(Prerequisites)限制修習過: 半導體元件物理(Semiconductor Physics and Devices)與微電子工程 (Microelectronic Engineering) 研究所程度相當之課程，所以大學部學生，恐怕無法吸收此研究所等級內容，只適合論文半導體元件研究相關博士班與碩士班同學修習。

course.description:
This course deals with the analysis and design of analog/mixed-signal integrated circuits. The 
objective is to help students developing a solid foundation of analyzing and designing 
analog/mixed-
signal integrated circuits. The students are asked to do homework to analyze circuits. Final 
project 
will be assigned to the students so that they can design a whole system circuit by using the 
analyzing 
skills. The lecture covers the following topics: fundamental CMOS device physics, device model, 
amplifier circuits, operational amplifiers, frequency response, stability, and data converter 
circuits.

course.description:
介紹常見材料檢測與分析技術(包含一般材料與半導體材料)。藉由介紹量測方法的基本原理與儀器，使同學廣泛了解未來面對不同材料
如何找尋適當的檢測工具。前半學期課程將介紹儀器使用與技術本身深層的數學物理背景，進而認識到儀器的量測限制，提供未來可能
的研究相關檢測知識。後半學期將邀請三大檢測廠商、工研院量測中心、儀器商介紹量測實際案例與儀器發展趨勢。
由於教室空間有限，因應量測知識需要的急迫性，本課程改成研究所學生優先修習。
course.objectives: Course keywords: 材料分析背景知識, X光相關技術, 電子相關技術, 其他光源技術, 產業鏈結      請詳細閱讀成績考核方式與請假規則參考書籍：無。上課方式為投影片與板書，投影片於eeclass提供。課程說明：預期從不同光源的方向代入下列技術介紹。期中前為技術原理介紹，期中後為業界實例。預期提到之相關技術：X射線光電子能譜(X-Ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy)X射線繞射分析(X-Ray Diffraction)三維X射線檢測(3D X-Ray Microscopy)小角度散射X射線散射(Small Angle X-Ray Scattering)原子力顯微鏡 (Atomic Force Microscopy)光學顯微鏡(Optical Microscopy)歐傑電子能譜 (Auger electron spectroscopy)白光干涉儀(White Light Interferometry)傅立葉轉換紅外線光譜(Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy )共軛焦顯微鏡（Confocal Microscopy）二次離子質譜分析 (Secondary Ion Mass Spectroscopy)超音波掃描顯微鏡(Scanning Acoustic Tomography)掃描式電子顯微鏡(Scanning Electron Microscopy)穿透式電子顯微鏡(Transmission Electron Microscopy)掃描穿透式電子顯微鏡(Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy)電子能量損失能譜(Electron Energy Loss Spectroscopy)能量色散X射線能譜(Energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy)聚焦電子束繞射(Convergent Beam Electron Diffraction)低能量電子繞射(Low Energy Electron Diffraction)背向散射電子繞射(Electron Back Scatter Diffraction）電子斷層掃描(Electron Tomography)原子探針技術(Atom Probe Tomography)成績考核：學期成績為課堂發問成績與廠商主管邀請演講出席點名成績加總，無考試。詳細規則將於第一堂課詳細說明。本學期將大量增加邀請廠商主管演講出席計次點名，同學按座位表入座，助教將於13:10與演講之間不定時拍照以統計出席，請同學勿遲到早退。遲到早退者以當次點名成績乘0.5。由於出席成績占比極高，且本門課不接受請假規避出席點名，因此若該實驗室外務過多(如常需要外地做實驗或常出國開會或實驗室同時間有會議等等)或學生身體不佳常因病缺席者，請勿選此課程。選擇此課程請同學要有成年人該有的成熟與心理準備。***** 極重要 *****出席判定規則：助教於13:10準時第一次拍照存證，該時間點請務必坐在位置上，勿以上廁所等任何理由離開座位。超過13:10才入座者亦不予通融。之後將於課程中不定時進行二次拍照。1.若第一次拍照時不在現場，但第二次或第三次在，視為遲到，該次出席成績乘0.5。2.若第一次拍照時在現場，但第二、三次都不在，視為早退，該次出席成績乘0.5。
